rationale.automation-bias: Skilled professionals report lazy delegation, shallow acceptance, over-reliance, and deskilling.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Faster generation shifts effort and pressure toward validation and debugging.
rationale.quality-debt: Participants report code bloat, brittleness, breakage, and degraded maintainability.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Practitioners test functionality, business logic, usability, and visual behavior.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Humans manually debug, review, retest, and decide deployment readiness.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Visible limitations and explanations help practitioners judge outputs and learn.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Agents forget intent and introduce unrequested components requiring human cleanup.
rationale.org-governance: Enterprise policies govern tool access, responsibility, disclosure, and data handling.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Participants demand persistent prompts, edit histories, attribution, and signoff records.
